name: Pizzeria Copacapana
kurzbeschreibung: **Pizzeria Copacabana in Kufstein** – Enjoy authentic Italian flavors in the heart of Tirol! Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a delicious **Calzone**, this cozy spot delivers fresh, handmade pizzas with a touch of Alpine charm. Pair your meal with a crisp **Radler** or a glass of local **Tiroler Wein** for the perfect evening. Just a short stroll from the **Inn River**, it’s the ideal stop for pizza lovers exploring **Kufstein** and beyond. Open daily—come for the food, stay for the vibe!
